name: The Daplorabulls

evidence.note: Band post: high-energy 6-piece band of dance, soul, funk and disco.
Eleanor's Lounge residency: come dance the night away with the band.
Channel of live covers such as I Love the Nightlife, Hot Stuff and You Should Be Dancing.

dancing.notes: Bills itself as a party and dance band and invites crowds to dance the night away; its videos are mostly disco and funk covers like Hot Stuff and Play That Funky Music.

description: Six-piece Long Island party band playing dance, soul, funk and disco covers, with a twice-monthly 'Feel Good Fridays' night at Eleanor's Lounge in Bohemia.
reviewNotes: Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). Popei's Clam Bar has Coram and Deer Park locations; Ira's List says Coram.
